item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q010_rossmann_family_function_divergence","answer":"In the current SCOPe release 2.08, these are three distinct families, not aliases of one family: Alcohol dehydrogenase-like, C-terminal domain is family c.2.1.1, SUNID 51736; CoA-binding domain is family c.2.1.8, SUNID 51900; and Potassium channel NAD-binding domain is family c.2.1.9, SUNID 63944. All three have the same parent superfamily, NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains, c.2.1, SUNID 51735. That superfamily sits in the NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains fold, c.2, SUNID 51734, under the Alpha and beta proteins (a/b) class, c, SUNID 51349. Biologically, SCOPe is therefore asserting a probable remote homologous relationship at the c.2.1 superfamily level, while keeping these domains separated at the family level to reflect stronger within-family similarity than between alcohol-dehydrogenase-like C-terminal, CoA-binding, and potassium-channel NAD-binding representatives. The shared Rossmann superfamily is enough to choose broad structural templates for the conserved NAD(P)-binding Rossmann core with care, but it is not enough to copy family-specific substrate chemistry, CoA binding, potassium-channel regulatory biology, active-site residues, oligomeric context, or ligand specificity from one of the three families to another without independent sequence, structural, ligand-binding, and biochemical evidence. The enclosing c.2 fold is an even weaker statement: SCOPe's homology endpoint marks the c.2.1 superfamily and the individual families as homology-implying, but explicitly warns that levels above superfamily, such as the c.2 fold, do not by themselves imply homology.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/levels","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/children?limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51734","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51734/homology"]}]}
